zh: 查询多达 10^5 次，但值域只到 10^6，而各位数字互不相同的正整数本身并不多（不到 17 万个）。
预先用 DFS 枚举所有不超过 10^6、首位非零且数字不重复的正整数并排序，每个查询用两次二分统计区间内的个数。
DFS 从 0 开始，每次在末尾追加一个未用过的数字（首位不能是 0），新数不超过 10^6 就记录并继续向下；排序后，对查询 [lower, upper] 输出“第一个大于 upper 的下标”减去“第一个不小于 lower 的下标”。
en: There can be 10^5 queries, but values only go up to 10^6, and positive integers with all-distinct digits are few (fewer than 170,000).
Enumerate once, by DFS, every positive integer up to 10^6 with no leading zero and no repeated digit, sort them, and answer each query with two binary searches.

The DFS starts at 0 and appends an unused digit each step (the first digit cannot be 0), recording and recursing while the number stays ≤ 10^6; after sorting, answer [lower, upper] with (first index whose value > upper) minus (first index whose value ≥ lower).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate all positive integers without repeated digits (at most 6 digits) once and sort them; for each query, count the closed range with two binary searches.

## Proof of correctness

The DFS always picks an unused digit and never starts with zero, so every number it produces is valid; every valid number corresponds, by its digits, to exactly one DFS path. After sorting, the difference between the binary-search index past the right end and the index before the left end equals exactly the number of valid numbers in the range.

## Complexity

O(U log U) preprocessing, O(q log U) for the queries, and O(U+q) space, where U is the number of valid numbers not exceeding one million.
